Real Number Monsters

Feed every falling number to the monster of its most specific set!

How to Play

  • ← → move the number • hold ↓ to fall fast • Space slams it in.
  • No keyboard? Drag the number with mouse / finger, or just tap a bin to send it straight there.
  • On a phone, use the colour bar under the monsters: slide to aim without covering the number, tap to drop. Turn it on or off from this screen.
  • P or Esc (or the ⏸️ button) pauses — the monsters and the number stay on screen so you can take your time. Restart and Main Menu appear in the top bar while paused.
  • The bins are nested: Natural inside Whole inside Integer inside Rational — and Irrational stands alone.
  • Feeding an inner monster feeds every monster around it too: +10 per happy monster. A natural number in the Natural bin scores +40!
  • Feed the wrong monster: −10 each. Not specific enough? Each deprived inner monster costs −10.
  • Round ends after 20 right or 10 wrong. Score never drops below 0.
  • Watch decimals with … — a repeating pattern means rational, no pattern means (most likely) irrational!
  • Stay sharp: some fractions reduce. 6⁄3 is really 2 — a natural number!
